blkD202324.csv.description: ASI (Annual Survey of Industries) Block D: characteristics and identifiers. Key columns: yr (reference year), blk (block code), ad01 (establishment/factory ID for joins), dI1–dI4 (block D indicators). Filter by yr for a specific year; join to other blocks on ad01 where applicable.

column_descriptions.yr: Reference year of the survey (e.g. 2023). Use in WHERE for year-specific queries.
column_descriptions.blk: Block or segment code. Use to filter by block type.
column_descriptions.ad01: Establishment identifier. Use to JOIN with other blocks when they share the same ID column.

blkE202324.csv.description: ASI Block E: fixed capital, investments, and related indicators. Key columns: yr, blk, AE01 (establishment ID; join key with Block F on AE01=AF01), EI1–EI8 (block E indicators). Use for capital and investment metrics; join to Block F on AE01=AF01 for combined analysis.

column_descriptions.yr: Reference year. Filter for a specific survey year.
column_descriptions.AE01: Establishment ID. Primary join key to Block F (AF01). Use AE01=AF01 in JOINs.

blkF202324.csv.description: ASI Block F: working capital, inputs, and operating metrics. Key columns: yr, blk, AF01 (join to Block E on AE01=AF01), F1–F13 (block F indicators). Use for inputs, costs, and operating aggregates; JOIN with Block E on AE01=AF01 for capital-and-operations analysis.

column_descriptions.AF01: Establishment ID. Join to Block E on AE01=AF01.

blkH202324.csv.description: ASI Block H: employment and labour-related indicators. Key columns: yr, blk, AH01 (establishment ID for joins), HI1–HI7 (block H indicators). Use for employment and labour metrics; join to other blocks on AH01 where they share the same ID scheme.

column_descriptions.AH01: Establishment ID. Use to JOIN with other blocks when they share this identifier.

blkI202324.csv.description: ASI Block I: output, revenue, or product-related indicators. Key columns: yr, blk, AI01 (establishment ID), II1–II7 (block I indicators). Use for output and revenue metrics; join on AI01 where other blocks use the same ID.

column_descriptions.AI01: Establishment ID. Join key when other blocks share this ID.

blkJ202324.csv.description: ASI Block J: additional sector or industry indicators. Key columns: yr, blk, AJ01 (establishment ID), J11–J113 (block J indicators). Use for block J metrics; join on AJ01 when other blocks share this identifier.

column_descriptions.AJ01: Establishment ID. Use to JOIN with other blocks.
